item.title: Firefighters battle N. Jefferson Street fire
item.description: A large brick home on the 2000 block of North Jefferson Street in Baldwin County sustained extensive damages when fire broke out in a rear bedroom Thursday afternoon.

item.title: Authorities foil intended prison drop at Hancock State Prison
item.description: A man and woman have been arrested in connection with the seizure of a drone and illegal items believed to have been destined for Hancock State Prison near Sparta on Feb. 5, local authorities say.

item.title: VAN HORN: What makes you an interesting person?
item.description: If what makes a person interesting can be measured by the books they’ve read, the people they’ve met, the places they’ve traveled, the art they’ve admired, the mountains they’ve climbed, the marathons they’ve run, or the national parks they’ve walked through, then the answer is easy.

item.title: EDITORIAL: State must address issues in corrections system
item.description: A Hancock State prisoner dies after a beating in his cell. Four deaths were reported in less than a week at Washington State Prison. Five inmates injured at Hancock State Prison.

item.title: GMC’s Harris wins Sgt. Christopher Monica 5K
item.description: Nicholas Harris put on a dazzling performance in winning the fourth annual Sgt. Christopher Monica Memorial 5K on Feb. 7.

item.title: MILLIANS: Memories from the ‘60s
item.description: I wasn’t born in Milledgeville, but my formative years were here — 1962-1970 — before I went away to college at the University of Georgia. It’s my hometown, even though I lived more years in Cincinnati, Ohio.

item.title: Brother, sister killed in WACO house fire
item.description: A Valentine’s Day house fire on the outskirts of Sandersville has left a brother and his sister dead, local authorities say.

item.title: UPDATE: WACO sheriff releases names of children killed in house fire
item.description: The names of the two children killed in a mobile home fire outside Sandersville Valentine’s morning have been released.
